newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand sees easing C/A deficit.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand sees easing C/A deficit.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Saturday the 1997 current account deficit should narrow to less than 7.5 percent of gross domestic product compared with 8.0 percent in 1996.

"I am confident we can bring the current account deficit this year down to less than 7.5 percent of GDP after the recent budget cuts," he told a meeting of the Association of Finance Companies in this resort town.
